text:
maria: Big thanks to @anu and @tyler for running the lightning onboarding session this morning. New folks already shipping tiny demo PRs 389
anu: glad it went well! special shout to @tyler for the crisp starter checklist. next time we'll bring the bagels earlier.
tyler: starter checklist is now a pinned doc in #devex. also we have leftover sesame bagels in the kitchen 9c0
raj: woohoo new contributors! I left a label on the bagel box (pls eat in moderation). major props to the mentors. :trophy:
nina: thank you both!! answered my million questions without eye-rolls. truly appreciated. :sparkles:
claire: can we make a tiny badge for folks who finish onboarding? i nominate "hatchling" with a confetti emoji.
hr-bot: New hire welcome pack delivered to maria for on-site pickup 381
maria: @claire love the badge idea. @tyler happy to help mock up a sticker. also printing a huge THANK YOU on the demo board.
anu: everyone who helped today gets a kudos in the weekly roundup. tagging leads to make sure it shows up in retention metrics. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
tyler: tiny brag: one of the new hires fixed a lint error and merged their first docs PR within the hour. instant legend.
raj: screenshot? we need evidence for the brag wall. :camera_with_flash:
nina: attaching proof: <screenshot_onboard_1.png> :heart_eyes:
claire: can we also start a rotating snack sponsor schedule? volunteers for next week?
maria: i'm game. i'll take week 3. thanks again to everyone who helped onboard and to the bagel brigade 95e
tyler: night shift of badges and bagels wins. see you all tomorrow. :wave:
